source.original_comment: The episode recording logic in remediate-parallel.md adds a new episode on every step but lacks a mechanism to cap the array size. The schema specifies maxItems: 10. Without a check, this will produce a goal file that violates the schema.

verifiable_metrics.name: Episode recording blocks without size cap
verifiable_metrics.command: python3 -c "content=open('commands/remediate-parallel.md').read(); idx=content.find('EPISODE RECORDING'); block=content[idx:idx+800]; print(0 if 'ge 10' in block or '[1:]' in block else 1)"
verifiable_metrics.verification_notes: The episode recording section must include a size guard before appending

complexity.reasoning: Simple addition of size guard before episode append

remediation.replacement: Add episode cap check: if episode_count >= 10, remove oldest before appending
remediation.guidance: Add before episode_id assignment: if [ "$episode_count" -ge 10 ]; then jq '.progress.iteration_episodes = .progress.iteration_episodes[1:]' ... fi
